# GovtExam AI - Verified Indian Government Job Intelligence Radar
> Authoritative, zero-cost, factual intelligence platform for Indian government recruitment notifications (SSC, Railways, UPSC, Banking, Defence, Police).

## Overview
GovtExam AI is designed for students seeking government jobs in India. Instead of forcing candidates to read 50-80 page official gazette PDFs, it provides a 10-second smart qualification matrix matching candidates by:
- 10th (Matriculation) Board Percentage
- 12th (Intermediate) Stream (PCM, PCB, Commerce, Arts) and Percentage
- Graduation Degree (B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Com, B.A., BCA, MBBS, etc.)
- Study Status: 1st/2nd/3rd Year, Final Year (Appearing), or Completed Graduate
- Reservation Category Age Relaxations (General, OBC +3 yrs, SC/ST +5 yrs, PwD +10 yrs)
